author: Kairos I
title: Erudite Annex v1.5: auto-tail, baseline fallback, PV detection
abstract: Builds baseline with schema fallbacks, detects PV sidecars (_pv or -pv), auto-selects tail threshold (top-25% bins), computes per-run js and tail_alpha, and writes updated annex summary+index.
